cases.sentence: Вот ___ которые Господь оставил, чтобы испытывать израилетян.
cases.translation: Now these are the nations which Yahweh left, to test Israel.
cases.explain: Земля is the grammatical subject of the clause, standing in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Господь оставил их, чтобы испытывать через ___.
cases.translation: Yahweh left them to test Israel through wars.
cases.explain: The preposition через (through) governs the accusative case.

cases.translation: The children of Israel lived surrounded by waters.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: They served gods on the mountains.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Израилетяне совершили зло в глазах Господа, и он отдал их в руки ___.
cases.translation: The Israelites did evil in Yahweh's sight, and he sold them into the hand of the king.
cases.explain: Possession after руки (hand) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: И земля покоилась в мире пред ___.
cases.translation: And the land rested before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition пред (before) governs the instrumental case when used in this context.

cases.sentence: Дух Господа пришел на ___, и он стал судьей Израиля.
cases.translation: The Spirit of Yahweh came upon a man, and he judged Israel.
cases.explain: The verb пришел на (came upon) with a person takes the accusative case, but here the genitive matches.

cases.translation: Yahweh delivered the enemy into the hands of a craftsman.
cases.explain: Possession after руки (hand) requires the genitive case.

reading.ru: Израилетяне жили среди Хананеев, Хеттов, Амареев, Ферезеев, Хеввеев и Иевусеев.
reading.question: Among which peoples did the children of Israel live?
options: The Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
reading.correct: The Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
reading.explain: The text explicitly lists all these peoples among whom Israel dwelt.

reading.ru: Они брали в жены их дочерей, отдавали своих дочерей за их сыновей.
reading.question: What type of intermarriage took place between Israel and these nations?
options: They married their daughters and gave their own daughters to them
reading.correct: They married their daughters and gave their own daughters to them
reading.explain: The text states they took their daughters as wives and gave their own daughters to their sons.

reading.ru: Израилетяне совершили зло в глазах Господа и служили Баалом и Ашером.
reading.question: What evil did the Israelites commit according to this verse?
options: They forgot God and served Baals and Asheroth
They refused to go to war
reading.correct: They forgot God and served Baals and Asheroth
reading.explain: The text describes their evil as forgetting the Lord their God and serving Baals and Asheroth.

reading.ru: Дух Господа сошел на него, он стал судьей Израиля и отправился воевать.
reading.question: What happened to Othniel when the Spirit of the Lord came upon him?
options: He judged Israel and went out to war
reading.correct: He judged Israel and went out to war
reading.explain: The text says the Spirit of Yahweh came on him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war.

reading.ru: Ехуд сделал обоюдоострый меч длиной в локоть и укрепил его под одеждой у правого бедра.
reading.question: What kind of weapon did Ehud make and how did he conceal it?
options: A two-edged sword a cubit long, hidden under his clothing on his right thigh
A bow and arrows hidden in his cart
A dagger in his left shoe
reading.correct: A two-edged sword a cubit long, hidden under his clothing on his right thigh
reading.explain: The text describes Ehud making a sword with two edges, a cubit in length, and wearing it under his clothing on his right thigh.

reading.ru: Ехуд не вытащил меча, и нечистоты вышли из тела царя.
reading.question: What happened when Ehud struck the king with his sword?
options: He didn't draw the sword out, and the king's waste came out
The sword broke inside the king
reading.correct: He didn't draw the sword out, and the king's waste came out
reading.explain: The text states Ehud did not draw the sword, and it came out behind as the king's waste came out.
